copy.curiosityHook: When an innocent school ritual invites something sinister across the threshold, can one sister keep her home safe?
copy.description: In 1991 Madrid, a teenage girl holds a school séance and soon suspects an evil presence has followed her home, threatening the younger siblings in her care.
copy.vibeSummary: Heavy, suspenseful apartment horror best watched alone with undivided attention.
copy.whyWatch: Director Paco Plaza grounds supernatural terror in the claustrophobic dread of a family apartment, delivering an escalating, atmospheric Spanish horror story.

allowedMaterial: Teen girl holding a séance at school
Suspecting an evil force has entered the apartment
Director Paco Plaza and Horror genre context
excludedMaterial: Ending and final fate of the family
